title: india_lp Institutional Mandate Record
description: A single named, dated commitment by a real education authority (Ministry of Education, NCERT under NEP 2020's mandate, a state education board) that calls for some form of curriculum coordination, competency-based reform, or cross-subject/holistic learning -- the computable unit for 'what does this authority actually require'. Modeled on deutsche_lp's/nys_lp's institutional-mandate-record.schema.json. Deliberately does NOT yet include a coordinationGrain-equivalent controlled vocabulary (Germany's fachuebergreifend/faecherverbindend/faecherintegrierend three-tier typology, or New York's interdisciplinaryExplicitness) -- this repo's founding session found real language in NEP 2020/NCF 2023 around 'holistic', 'multidisciplinary', and 'interdisciplinary' study, but has not done the equivalent close-reading research pass deutsche_lp did for Thueringen's own Leitgedanken or nys_lp did for NYSED's own materials to justify minting a controlled vocabulary yet. crossSubjectApproach is free text for now, not required -- revisit as a closed enum once real mandate records exist to derive one from, per this repo's own verification-first discipline (don't force a borrowed vocabulary that hasn't been checked against India's own texts). No mandate records exist in this repo yet as of its founding session (2026-09-30) -- statementText would require quoting actual government curriculum-policy text, which this repo's founding session deliberately deferred pending the real legal review named in docs/strategy/2026-09-30-india-legal-review-scope.md.

jurisdiction.description: 'IN' for a national NEP-2020/NCF-level mandate; 'IN-KA' / 'IN-MH' etc. for a single state's own curriculum-board document.

issuingBody.description: Free text, e.g. 'National Council of Educational Research and Training (NCERT)', 'Ministry of Education, Government of India', 'Maharashtra State Bureau of Textbook Production and Curriculum Research (Balbharati)'. Not a controlled vocabulary.

mandateType.description: 'national-policy-framework' = NEP 2020 itself or an equally broad national policy document. 'national-curriculum-framework' = NCF (e.g. NCF 2023) or a subject-specific national syllabus document. 'state-curriculum-framework' = a State Curriculum Framework or state syllabus document. 'state-policy-announcement' = a state-level policy direction not yet a formal curriculum document. 'licensing-policy' = a body's own stated copyright/redistribution terms (e.g. Balbharati's Revised Policy) -- included as its own type because, for this repo's purposes, a licensing policy is itself a mandate worth tracking precisely, distinct from curriculum content.

crossSubjectApproach.description: Free text describing how this mandate's own text frames cross-subject/interdisciplinary/holistic learning, if at all -- deliberately not yet a controlled vocabulary (see this schema's top-level description). Optional.

statementText.description: The mandate's own text, quoted exactly as read in the primary source. Do not paraphrase where a verbatim quote is available. Governed by accessTier below -- see that field before adding a long quotation here.

targetDate.description: If the mandate names a completion/target horizon distinct from its adoption date.

accessTier.description: How much of the underlying mandate document this record actually keeps, chosen per-source based on what's legally safe to redistribute -- same four values and meaning as deutsche_lp's/nys_lp's identical field. See this schema's top-level description for why this repo's founding session default is 'citation-only' pending the real legal review named in docs/strategy/2026-09-30-india-legal-review-scope.md.

licenseOrRightsNote.description: The legal basis for storing this mandate's statementText at the accessTier chosen above. Mirrors OpenLPM's standards_documents.license_or_rights_note field (openlpm migration 019) for ecosystem-wide naming consistency.
